summaries.summary: A flow chart illustrating the steps of association mapping in plants, starting with two parental plants (P1 and P2) forming a mapping population. After DNA extraction and PCR, the next step is electrophoresis segregation analysis, which uses RAPD markers (E, F, G) to generate a genotypic dataset. This data is then processed with software like MAPMAKER/JOINMAP/GMendel to produce a linkage map.
key_facts: DNA extraction and PCR is followed by electrophoresis segregation analysis
RAPD markers (E, F, G) are used for analysis
Genotypic data set is generated from marker patterns
Linkage map is produced using MAPMAKER/JOINMAP/GMendel software
